endorsements.quote: Connecting these models to current pharmacological databases would enable access to the latest drug interaction guidelines, side effect profiles, and dosage recommendations.

By involving medical experts in model refinement, especially for context-specific information and decision-making guidance, developers can better align AI outputs with the nuanced requirements of personalized medicine.
Clear disclaimers and transparent communication about AI limitations can help position LLMs as supplements to professional healthcare guidance.
Looking forward, establishing medical AI ethical review boards, similar to institutional review boards for clinical research, could provide structured oversight of LLM implementation.

unlisted_practices: Establish regulatory oversight and clear boundaries for LLM use in patient medication guidance so tools serve as supplements rather than standalone resources.
Include clear disclaimers in LLM medication guidance about the importance of professional medical consultation.
Emphasize the provisional nature of LLM guidance in austere environments and direct users to seek professional care as soon as possible.
Provide targeted training of LLMs in medical ethics and patient safety to reduce risk in high-stakes areas such as mental health, reproductive health, and complex medication management.
Establish strategic partnerships between AI companies and medical institutions to support ongoing model validation and improvement.

screen.reason: This is a perspective piece analyzing the potential and pitfalls of large language models for patient-centered medication guidance and recommending regulatory oversight and deployment principles.
